n.no: User-facing caller for distributed kv store.
Distribute incoming connections across healthy instances for distributed kv store.
Route ordered key ranges to their Raft leader. Writes commit after a majority quorum; reads use leader leases or ReadIndex. Split hot ranges and retry stale routing metadata.
Each range has three replicas and versioned committed log entries. A new leader repairs followers by log replication and snapshots.
Maintain range boundaries, leader epochs and replica membership; fence obsolete leaders.

apis.request: No request body; optional consistency and version context.
apis.note: Return causal context for Dynamo reconciliation, or a committed leader-read version for range consensus.
Acknowledge only after the required replica quorum; retry using the same operation ID or version precondition.
